candidates.description: This vector represents linguistic suffixes and character combinations, particularly from Thai script transliteration and common English morphological endings.
This vector represents common Thai vocabulary words and morphemes.
This feature vector activates strongly on conjunctions, relational particles, and connecting words predominantly in Thai and English.
These tokens represent common Thai character sequences, monosyllabic words, and sub-word units frequently used in the Thai language.
This feature vector represents the Thai noun-forming prefix and word for "act," "process," or "system" (การ).
This vector represents multilingual morphological suffixes and roots related to labor, work, and occupational terms.
This feature vector represents concepts and terminology related to robots, robotics, and artificial intelligence.
This feature vector activates strongly on mixed multilingual text fragments, particularly Thai script tokens and miscellaneous technical abbreviations or proper noun subwords.
This feature vector activates strongly on proper names and personal identifiers across multiple languages and scripts.
This vector activates for common name prefixes, word fragments, and phonetic components beginning with the letters "ro" or "rob".
